name: uscreen
label: Uscreen
description: All-in-one video monetization platform for creating, hosting, and selling online courses, memberships, and video content.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
To get your API key:
    1. Log in to your Uscreen account
    2. Contact your Customer Success Manager to have an API key (X-Store-Token) issued.

create_user.label: Create User
create_user.description: Creates a new user and optionally sends them a welcome email to your storefront.

password.label: Password
password.description: The new user's password. Leave blank if sending an invite email.

opted_in_for_news_and_updates.label: Opted in for News and Updates
opted_in_for_news_and_updates.description: If set to true, the new user will receive news and updates.
